title: Stance-and-Slide Shuttle
description: Players slide through a shuttle pattern touching lines on the floor, building the lateral quickness and low stance needed for on-ball defense.

content.objective: Build quick, low lateral slides between the floor's natural lines.
content.setup: Players start at the free-throw line facing the sideline in a defensive stance.
instructions: Slide to the left elbow, touch the floor, then slide back to the free-throw line.
Slide to the right elbow, touch the floor, then slide back.
Repeat the full pattern three times without standing up between slides.
Finish with five seconds of fast feet in the stance.
coachingPoints: Stay low through every touch, not just at the start.
Push off the trail foot rather than crossing the feet.
Keep the chest up even while touching the floor.
commonMistakes: Standing up tall to touch the floor instead of staying low.
Crossing the feet during the slide.
Standing upright instead of staying in a low stance.
content.safety: Make sure the floor markings are clearly visible and the space is clear.
